```{r, echo = F, warning = F, message = F}
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '~/Documents/Davis/R-Projects/organicseed_adoption')
```

## Model selection and fit

```{r, echo = F}
tablea1 <- read.csv('tables/tablea1.csv') ; 
colnames(tablea1) <- c("Term", rep(c("Mean", "SE"), 5)) ; 
tablea1[is.na(tablea1)] <- "" ; 
kbl(tablea1, booktabs = T, caption = 'Model comparison results') %>% kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "hold_position")) %>% 
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Model 1" = 2, "Model 2" = 2, "Model 3" = 2, "Model 4" = 2, "Model 5" = 2))
```

```{r, echo = F}
tablea2 <- read.csv('tables/tablea2.csv') ; 
colnames(tablea2) <- c("Model", "WAIC", "Maximum Likelihood", "CPO") ; 
kbl(tablea2, booktabs = T, caption = 'Goodness of fit across models') %>% kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position")) 
```

## Full model results  


```{r, echo = F}
tablea3 <- read.csv('tables/tablea3.csv') ; 
colnames(tablea3) <- c("Term", "Mean estimate", "Standard error") ; 
kbl(tablea3, booktabs = T, caption = 'Full model results') %>% kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position")) 
```
